subject.title: auth probe: token-type profile not counted as effective for claude-cli provider (TUI stuck on 'auth expired')

question: Should OpenClaw land the OAuth-first token/setup-token fallback from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98105 to close this auth-status bug?
rationale: Provider auth status and explicit auth-order behavior are compatibility-sensitive, and the current open PR is ready for maintainer judgment rather than a new automated repair job.

options.title: Land the linked PR
options.body: Accept the gateway rollup policy where OAuth remains primary and token/setup-token profiles become the fallback when no effective OAuth profile exists.

options.title: Request a different auth policy
options.body: Keep this issue open but ask the PR author to move the fix to a different status/runtime boundary if maintainers reject gateway-level token fallback.

options.title: Close the PR and keep this issue
options.body: Use this only if the current PR direction is not acceptable but the false expired-auth warning still needs a different implementation.

recommendation.title: Land the linked PR
recommendation.body: Accept the gateway rollup policy where OAuth remains primary and token/setup-token profiles become the fallback when no effective OAuth profile exists.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to steipete and his history covers token auth profile support and the active maintainer-prepared proof on the linked PR.
